{{Top|leg}}
A '''wavespeeder''' was an aquatic vehicle employed on [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] for transport. Wavespeeders were employed on the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] to travel between the floating [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] had three wavespeeders assigned to it as part of its vehicle complement.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
